IDENT.title: Architecture and knowledge modelling for self-organized reconfiguration management of cyber-physical production systems
IDENT.venue: International Journal of Computer Integrated Manufacturing

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: Thus, this layer covers the implementation of the methodology for the self-organized reconfigura­tion management, by means of a MAS.

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: Digital representatives of each production module as well as representations of abstract assets like the system configurations interact

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: The knowledge com­ponents are realized in a distributed manner and are held within the proxy layer as described above.

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: The knowledge modelling is realized through a UML information model, which can be integrated into the system utilizing XML files.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: it is possible to utilize a multi-objective simulated annealing or a multi-objective genetic algorithm

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: the approach allows the introduction of additional SBO agents and thus partial or complete paralleliza­tion.

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: realized in Java, utilizing the Java Agent Development Framework (JADE).

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: 'CPPM Agents' are aware of their alter­native CPPM configurations

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: CPM models with module configurations, components, installation efforts, states, non-functional parameters, from XML files
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: for each available XML file, containing the information of a CPM, the 'Simple API for XML (SAX)' is utilized

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: Furthermore, it provides the current configuration to the 'Reconfiguration Demand Agent'.

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: Hence, it contains all possible production sequences that can be con­ducted by the currently applied CPPS configuration

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: is updated based on the discovery server information of the SOA

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: the necessary knowledge must be held and provided to the system's distributed components

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: the implementation of the multi-agent system complies with the FIPA specifica­tions

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the system configuration with the best assigned utility is selected for deployment.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: The discovery server depicts a service broker

E_LEARNING__explores_beyond_predefined_e.evidence_quote: there is no need to apply reasoning to derive new knowledge, or to enable a constant evolu­tion

E_LEARNING__uses_simulation_for_explorat.evidence_quote: an optimization that runs the simulation multiple times with varying para­meters

E_LEARNING__simulation_model_source.evidence_quote: for a discrete event simulation based on state machines running in parallel

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: The prototypical imple­mentation covers a modular production system with a matrix layout, simulated in Unity

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: measure the reconfiguration and production efforts in terms of time, cost and energy

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: Both trigger types, i.e. requirements changes (through new production orders) and component failures, were tested several times.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: seven reconfigurable CPPMs with 20 configurations are available, offering 64 services.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: The system provides discrete manufacturing services such as drilling, milling or punching

H_STANDARDS__standards_referenced.evidence_quote: in accordance with the literature and especially with the RAMI 4.0 specification DIN SPEC 91,345

H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.evidence_quote: the authors choose to follow a novel UML/XML-based approach

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: it is possible to achieve interoperability and to cope with possible vendor heterogeneity by the utilization of a common infor­mation model

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: it reacts to occurring triggers (i.e. require­ments changes or component failures)

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Agents used for reconfiguration management (MAPE-K) rather than control; control handled by separate SOA; simulation-based multi-objective optimization of time/cost/energy; intelligent products are OPC UA service consumers, not agents.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: The control of the production system is handled by a dedicated SOA (the SBC) rather than using the MAS.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Knowledge modelling and management concept claimed mandatory.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: a knowledge mod­elling and management concept is a mandatory prerequisite.
